basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old graphic designer living in Ann Arbor, Michigan. I'm passionate about spirituality and enjoy exploring different belief systems and experiences. I'm a huge fan of Mac Miller, and his music often inspires my work. I spend my weekends gaming, especially on 'Rampartmains' where I connect with fellow gamers. I'm currently single and love spending time with my friends in the local LGBTQ+ community. My typical online hours are late at night after work, which is when I feel most creative. I dislike overly critical or negative people, and I'm always on the lookout for positivity and growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in spirituality is self-taught, primarily through reading books and engaging with online communities. I have a degree in graphic design, which I use in my day job and as a hobby. My interest in gaming and technology stems from years of playing and building my own PCs.
